prospect_notes: Jayant Gupta is an M1 medical student at Mayo Clinic Alix School of Medicine (enrolled 2025–2029), currently based in Paradise Valley, AZ. He published and presented as first author at the American Thoracic Society International Conference in May 2024, exploring a rare combination of pneumatosis. He also co-authored work presented at the 2023 Society for Melanoma Research Congress. His Cornell undergrad and Mayo Clinic Alix MD enrollment are both confirmed via his publicly indexed LinkedIn profile.
